title: 美国国债5%收益：香港银行股5到6%，散户买汇丰前该看哪个数？
speaker: How Hong

segments.en: I mean, rising rates will usually help the financials, but then again, you see what's happening in Europe,
segments.zh: 我的意思是，利率上升通常有利于金融板块，但话说回来，你看看欧洲的情况，

segments.en: and I think Hong Kong is really taking a bite from this sort of euro crisis that we're seeing
segments.zh: 我认为香港确实受到了我们看到的这种欧洲市场压力的影响

segments.en: when it comes to France and the like.
I'm just wondering, how should I look at financials now? I think Europe is a con case.
segments.zh: 我想知道，现在应该如何看待金融板块？我认为欧洲是个反面案例。

segments.en: I think for the US, the economy or the market? I think both are a con case.
segments.zh: 我认为对美国来说，经济还是市场？我认为两者都是反面案例。

segments.en: I think that's one of the reasons why they resort to trade war with China to try to resolve the situation.
segments.zh: 我认为这是他们诉诸对华贸易摩擦以试图解决局面的原因之一。

segments.en: I think with the financial here in Hong Kong, because many of the names that we saw just now on the screen like chess pieces, then charting all that,
segments.zh: 我认为香港的金融板块，因为刚才屏幕上看到的许多名字，像棋子和渣打等，

segments.en: they have been a user provider for many of the Hong Kong investors.
segments.zh: 它们一直是许多香港投资者的收益来源。

segments.en: In Hong Kong, one of the most popular traits is that you have money you buy into HSBC,
segments.zh: 在香港，最流行的做法之一就是有钱就买汇丰，

segments.en: and then you get five, six percent yield. It's better than putting your money in the savings account.
segments.zh: 然后获得5%到6%的收益。这比把钱放在储蓄账户里好。

segments.en: But I think now with the US, it's using 5 percent.
segments.zh: 但我认为现在美国提供5%的收益。

segments.en: I think much of the retail money will sting twice before they buy HSBC.
segments.zh: 我认为很多散户资金在买汇丰之前会三思。

segments.en: And that is why with the US, you are searching, then we're actually seeing pressure on the HSBC.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么随着美国收益上升，我们实际上看到汇丰面临压力。

segments.en: I think for the last couple of weeks, we're actually seeing a huge retail flow into US, HSBC as well.
segments.zh: 我认为过去几周，我们实际上看到大量散户资金流入美国，也流入汇丰。

segments.en: Why not, right? When I say, yeah, five, six percent.
segments.zh: 为什么不呢？当我说，是的，5%到6%。

segments.en: So what are the opportunities then in Chinese markets specifically?
segments.zh: 那么具体到中国市场，机会在哪里？
